# `kaolin/index.js`

> **Source:** `engine/kaolin/index.js`

engine/kaolin — Kaolin-equivalent 3D Geometry Toolkit WebGPU-native geometry operations inspired by NVIDIA Kaolin. Provides representation conversions, mesh ops, SDF tools, point cloud ops, and physics bridges for the engine's particle/softbody/mesh/voxel systems. Usage: import { ops } from '../kaolin/index.js'; const he = new ops.mesh.HalfEdgeMesh(positions, indices); const normals = ops.mesh.computeVertexNormals(positions, indices);
